script.title: PARTY INTRODUCTIONS
script.scene_zh: 家庭派對 · 初次聊天
script.story_hook: Two strangers become friends at a crowded party.
script.intro_zh: 兩個陌生人在熱鬧派對上結為朋友。
script.welcome_en: Hey everyone, welcome back! Today we're making friends at a party.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，各位，歡迎回來！今天我們來練習在派對上交朋友。
script.outro: That's a wrap! See you next time, friends.
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！朋友們，下次見。
script.practice_intro_en: Ready? Let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 準備好了嗎？我們一起逐句跟讀。

script.youtube_title: 【🎉派對自我介紹】「怎麼認識主人」💬必學開場句，3個萬能破冰句型，聽完就能開口聊天✨｜Party English
script.youtube_title_en: "How Do You Know Emma?" — Introducing Yourself at a Party
script.youtube_description:
不敢開口破冰？派對上認識新朋友的英文其實超簡單！跟著 Lena 在一場擁擠的家庭派對裡，練習最實用的三件事：問對方怎麼認識主人、聊自己的工作、記住並重複對方的名字。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完下次派對就能開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Too shy to break the ice at a party? This real-sounding English conversation fixes that. Follow Lena as she meets a stranger at a crowded house party and practices the three moves that matter: asking how someone knows the host, talking about work, and repeating names so they stick. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA and translations, then a repeat-after-me section so you can use it at your next party.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
youtube_tags: how do you know the host
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎉派對自我介紹英文｜問認識主人・聊工作・重複名字｜聽完就會開口破冰｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
派對上站著滑手機，不敢跟人聊天？
英文不夠順，開場第一句該說什麼？

這一集帶大家走進一場擠滿人的家庭派對，跟著剛到場的 Lena 從一句「um, hi」開始，練習問對方怎麼認識主人、聊聊各自的工作、記住並重複彼此的名字，最後自然地約著去拿一塊披薩。

你會聽到：
🎈 破冰開場：例如「So how do you know Emma?」、「I don't know anyone here yet.」。
💼 工作小聊：例如「What do you do there?」、「I'm a nurse over at City General.」。
🗣️ 名字來回：例如「Nice meeting you too, Lena」、「Small world!」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段派對對話變成你的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下一次派對，換你主動開口，朋友就多起來了！
script.thumbnail_action: raising a paper cup in a small greeting

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, hi, I don't know anyone here yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /əm haɪ aɪ doʊnt noʊ ˈɛniwʌn hɪr jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 呃，嗨，我在這裡還不認識任何人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? Me neither, it's such a crowd.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli mi ˈniðər ɪts sʌtʃ ə kraʊd/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我也是，人也太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So how do you know Emma?
dialogue.zh: 所以你怎麼認識艾瑪的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We work together at the design studio.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɜrk təˈɡɛðər æt ðə dɪˈzaɪn ˈstudjoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們一起在設計工作室上班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice! And what do you do there?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs ənd wʌt du ju du ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 噢，很好！你在那裡做什麼工作？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do the website layouts, mostly.
dialogue.zh: 我主要做網頁版面設計。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds harder than it looks!
dialogue.zh: 聽起來比看起來難多了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe. Anyway, I'm Jack, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ˈɛniweɪ aɪm dʒæk baɪ ðə weɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lena! Nice to meet you, Jack.
dialogue.zh: 我是莉娜，很高興認識你，傑克。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice meeting you too! Great playlist, huh?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈmitɪŋ ju tu ɡreɪt ˈpleɪˌlɪst hʌk/
dialogue.zh: 也很高興認識你！這歌單真棒，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! I've been humming that song all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪv bɪn ˈhʌmɪŋ ðæt sɔŋ ɔl deɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! So what do you do, Lena?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ soʊ wʌt du ju du ˈlinə/
dialogue.zh: 哈！那莉娜你是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm a nurse over at City General.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ə nɜrs ˈoʊvər æt ˈsɪti ˈdʒɛnərəl/
dialogue.zh: 我是市立醫院的護理師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way, my sister works there too!
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ maɪ ˈsɪstər wɜrks ðɛr tu/
dialogue.zh: 不會吧，我姊也在那裡工作！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small world! Which department is she in?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑl wɜld wɪtʃ dɪˈpɑrtmənt ɪz ʃi ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 世界真小！她在哪個部門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Physical therapy, second floor I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, it was really great meeting you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪt wʌz ˈrɪli ɡreɪt ˈmitɪŋ ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here! Grab a slice before we go?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪr ɡræb ə slaɪs bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我也是！去拿一塊披薩再走？
